dataset.title: EngineAD: A Real-World Vehicle Engine Anomaly Detection Dataset

protocol.access_note: The iSMART Lab page states that EngineAD is public and no access request is required; all published version 2.2 files were unrestricted.
caveats: Some 300-point segments contain mixed normal/anomaly labels; alternate any-positive metrics expose this aggregation sensitivity.
Labels are segment/point labels, not event onset/offset intervals; false alarms per week and event recall are not estimable.
The published eight-component PCA transform was fit at fleet level and includes held-out vehicles, so raw-sensor representation is not independently refit.
Segments within a truck are serially dependent; pooled calibration quantiles do not provide a distribution-free 5% false-alarm guarantee.
Original timestamps and engine-on block identifiers are absent; lag differences may bridge unobserved real-world gaps between adjacent serialized segments.
Only five test vehicles; report per-vehicle outcomes and seed ranges, not population-level certainty.
This is a separate exploratory benchmark and does not satisfy the preregistered real-field event-level cohort gate.

label_convention.primary: first point label in each segment, matching the upstream baseline.py convention
label_convention.sensitivity: positive if any of the 300 point labels is anomalous
label_convention.training_and_calibration: only segments whose 300 point labels are all normal

protocol.primary_metric: segment average precision using first-row labels; any-positive sensitivity also reported
protocol.scope: exploratory segment-level asset-held-out encoder study; not event-level validation
protocol.score: squared L2 norm of the projected, noise-whitened CNN embedding
protocol.threshold: 95% order statistic calibrated only on all-point-normal calibration segments; empirical, no exchangeability guarantee claimed
protocol.training_rule: all-point-normal segments only; projection groups break at any mixed/anomalous segment and vehicle boundary
